client/src/components/roles/RolePeoplePa.name: Role holders

client/src/components/schedules/CronTest.name: Schedule tester

client/src/components/services/ServiceLi.name: Services list
client/src/components/services/ServiceLi.description: Lists the running services with their state, uptime and memory use.

client/src/components/services/serviceTe.name: Service test samples

client/src/components/services/useServic.name: Service controls

client/src/components/solutions/Solution.description: Shows the setup instructions written for a Solution, with full formatting.

client/src/components/solutions/Solution.description: Walks through a Solution's outstanding setup one step at a time.

client/src/components/solutions/Solution.name: Uninstall notice

client/src/components/solutions/Solution.name: Update a Solution
client/src/components/solutions/Solution.description: Shows what a newer version changes before it is applied.

client/src/components/solutions/Workspac.name: Workspace import
client/src/components/solutions/Workspac.description: Brings in a workspace from a repository or uploaded package, showing what will be added.

client/src/components/tables/ClaimRefere.name: Custom claim help

client/src/components/tables/CodeEditor..name: Structured editor

client/src/components/tables/CustomClaim.name: Custom claim editor

client/src/components/tables/DocumentRec.name: Record list

client/src/components/tables/PolicyRefer.name: Policy reference
client/src/components/tables/PolicyRefer.description: Explains the parts of a table policy with worked examples and common mistakes.

client/src/components/tables/TableFilter.name: Record filters
